thread:
Ravi Kumar (AE): FYI prospect asked for a completed CAIQ + a clear shared-responsibility matrix for the POC. Need volunteers to draft answers and call out anything that blocks sales this week.
Claire Ops (GRC): I can own the CAIQ responses. Can someone confirm if the POC runs in customer's AWS account or in our Hosted environment?
Priya Shah (Solutions Eng): POC is mostly in customer's AWS VPC per the SOW draft — they want to test latency & network egress. They may accept a hosted fallback if needed. -> affects KMS/keys and logging ownership.
Mateo Rivera (SE): Pricing question: if we run a short Dedicated reservation for the POC (2-week burst), what's ballpark cost? Customer asked for estimate to include in procurement.
Alice Tran (Eng): Quick note on ownership: Hosted API: Redwood manages KMS and control plane, customer data encrypted at rest with Redwood-managed keys by default. Private/VPC or on-prem: customer can bring their own KMS (BYOK) and we integrate with their CMK. I'll add exact CAIQ field mappings.
Claire Ops (GRC): @Alice please map the CAIQ sections: e.g., IA-ENCRYPTION-AT-REST, KMS key lifecycle, LOGGING & MONITORING retention, ACCESS CONTROL (RBAC), and NETWORK BOUNDARIES.
SecurityBot: New SIG/CAIQ request created: SR-9876. Assigned to Claire Ops (GRC). Link: https://redwood.app/sigs/SR-9876
Ravi Kumar (AE): Customer also wants explicit answers on: who owns logs for the POC (CloudTrail/flow logs), whether we can deliver a SOC2-type assurance for the POC, and whether data egress is auditable. Put those near top.
Priya Shah (Solutions Eng): For POC in customer VPC: we push inference containers into their subnet (Private deployment) — customer owns VPC, subnets, SGs, and KMS; Redwood owns runtime binary/agents and application logs we emit to stdout unless they configure a sidecar. We'll need a short config guide for onboarding.
Alice Tran (Eng): Draft snippet I will include in CAIQ: `Ownership: Networking, VPC, and KMS -> Customer. Runtime binary, model weights, inference logs -> Redwood (unless configured to forward to customer).` Will add exceptions for Hosted.
Mateo Rivera (SE): For pricing: short Dedicated burst estimate = rough $X-$Yk / week depending on GPU class. @Finance: can we get a ballpark to share with procurement? Customer expects an order-of-magnitude.
Claire Ops (GRC): I'll prepare the CAIQ answers and a one-page shared-resp matrix. Timeline: need draft by EOD Thursday to review with legal Friday. Is that doable?
Ravi Kumar (AE): EOD Thursday works for sales cycle. @Priya @Alice please flag any blockers (esp. around BYOK integration or audit logs) by COB tomorrow.
Priya Shah (Solutions Eng): Blocker: if customer requires HSM-backed keys (external to AWS KMS) we need an ops runbook; unsure if we can integrate for a 2-week POC without extra ops time. I'll investigate and report tomorrow.
Alice Tran (Eng): FYI technical detail: for Hosted we perform envelope encryption and don't export plaintext keys. For Private we support customer CMKs via IAM role + KMS key policy. I will note required IAM permissions for the CAIQ answer.
Claire Ops (GRC): Linking working doc: https://redwood.app/sigs/caiq-mapping-9876 (internal). I'll add the RBAC matrix and retention defaults (90 days for logs by default, configurable).
Ravi Kumar (AE): Perfect. Also need a short blurb on fallback: if Dedicated capacity is unavailable we can failover to a lower-SLA hosted model — include that in reliability Qs.
Mateo Rivera (SE): I'll draft the pricing note and include an optional line item for Dedicated burst + BYOK integration effort.
SecurityBot: Reminder — SOC2 evidence requests must go through Evidence Portal; pick sensitive answers for escalation.
Claire Ops (GRC): Action items:
- Alice: CAIQ field-by-field mapping + IAM perms (due tomorrow)
- Priya: BYOK/HSM feasibility & ops impact (due tomorrow)
- Mateo: POC pricing estimate + optional line items (due EOD today)
- Claire: compile CAIQ + shared-resp matrix and send draft by Thu EOD
Ravi Kumar (AE): Thanks team — I'll escalate procurement timeline to customer and ask for sample ATO docs they need.
Priya Shah (Solutions Eng): Quick Q: should we include a sample Terraform snippet for KMS role binding in the CAIQ appendix? I think it helps them.
Alice Tran (Eng): Yes, include a tiny snippet. Example:

```terraform
resource "aws_iam_role" "redwood_kms_role" {
  name = "redwood-kms-access"
  # trust policy for Redwood service
}
```

Keep it non-production, just illustrative.
Claire Ops (GRC): Good — keep codebits illustrative only. I'll redact any operational secrets.
Ravi Kumar (AE): OK — callout done. I'll update the thread if customer pushes any additional asks. :thumbsup:
